title: Machine Maintenance Interval Tracker
dataSources: Print jobs (`octoprint:job`), printer firmware telemetry (`printer:telemetry`), filament spools (`filament:spool`), CNC/laser jobs (`cnc:job`), workshop air (`workshop:air`), cordless tool batteries (`tool:battery`).
app: OctoPrint / Klipper (Moonraker) print servers, printer firmware telemetry, filament spool tracking, CNC/laser job logs, and workshop air/tool sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=printer:telemetry
| stats sum(print_time_s) as run_s by printer
| eval run_hours=round(run_s/3600,0), since_service=run_hours%250, due_in=250-since_service
| where due_in<40
| sort due_in
description: Counts machine hours since the last service and reminds you when lubrication or belt checks are due.
value: Preventive maintenance on printed hours avoids the mid-print failures that neglected machines eventually suffer.
implementation: Accumulate machine hours; schedule weekly and flag printers approaching a service interval.
visualization: Table of printers with hours until the next service due.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how many hours your machines have run and reminds you when they need a bit of maintenance.
